note: Values that may stay until the source or the design changes. Every entry names the token occurrence, the source node it belongs to and the reason. The list must shrink: an entry that stops matching fails the check. The design request lists these values.

exceptions.reason: The source description is 18/26 Regular; the captured library exposes no regular 18px text style (Body/Body Big is semibold only). Design-blocked: the value is listed in docs/design-defaults.md §5 and asked in the open request docs/design-requests/2026-11-26-foundation-remainder.md (issue #193).

The truncated cell width is a caller-overridable fallback (`column.maxWidth ?? defaultTruncatedWidth`), not a value the component asserts: the source samples its columns at 114/153/59/59/59/89/112 and never states a truncation cap. Every consumer that sets `column.maxWidth` replaces it. Kept until the source publishes the cap; asked in docs/design-requests/2026-11-26-foundation-remainder.md (issue #193).

A skip control has to stay reachable while an overlay is open, so it sits above the overlay order (`z-50`) rather than inside it. The library publishes no z-index scale; the value asked in docs/design-requests/2026-11-26-foundation-remainder.md (issue #193) becomes its token.

The source L3 label is 12/14.4 while the `label-mini` text style carries 12/16, so the heading overrides the line-height of the style it draws. Off-scale: no leading token carries 1.2; asked in docs/design-requests/2026-11-26-foundation-remainder.md (issue #193).

The indeterminate indicator re-times the built-in pulse to 1.4s ease-in-out, which no motion token names; `motion-reduce:animate-none` already discharges the reduced-motion contract. The timing asked in docs/design-requests/2026-11-26-foundation-remainder.md (issue #193) becomes the token.

The source draws the pending dot's halo as a 6 px ring of the ink colour at 35%, an effect no elevation token carries: the three published shadows are drop shadows, not rings. Which step owns a ring, and whether the halo is a colour token or a mix of `--pui-foreground`, is asked in docs/design-requests/2026-11-26-foundation-remainder.md (issue #193).
